description:
Title: Building a House

You want to build a tree house.
First you collect your requirements, and send them to a tree house architect.
The architect sends you back a draft, which you refine multiple times with additional requirements.
You then create the list of needed materials from the plan.
These materials fall into several categories, you order them from several online stores.
While the order is processed, you send messages to several of your friends to build the house.
After the house is built, you send invitations for a tree house party to your friends.
In order to buy the snacks for the party, a list of people that attend the party is created.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_TreeHouse"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/treehouse">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TreeHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_You"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree House Architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequirementsToArchitect" name="Requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuildRequestToFriends" name="Build request" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestFriendsBuild" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_HouseBuiltFromFriends" name="House built" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="ReceiveTask_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InvitationsToFriends" name="Party invitation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Building a Tree House (You)" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_TreeHouseWish" name="Want to build a tree house"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to architect"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft from architect"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Refinement" name="Draft received"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_RefineDraft" name="Refine draft with additional requirements"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Split_Refine" name="Further refinement needed?" default="Flow_NoFurtherRefinement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create list of needed materials from plan"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_OrderMaterials" name="Order materials from online stores">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Split_Order" name="Order placed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RequestFriendsBuild" name="Send build request to friends"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_OrdersProcessed" name="Orders processed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrdersProcessed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_HouseBuilt" name="Receive house built notification"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Join_Order" name="House built and orders processed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendInvitations" name="Send party invitations to friends"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of party attendees"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PartyPrepared" name="Attendee list created"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_TreeHouseWish" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Merge_Refinement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Merge_Refinement" targetRef="UserTask_RefineDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="UserTask_RefineDraft" targetRef="Split_Refine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreRefinement" name="Yes" sourceRef="Split_Refine" targetRef="Merge_Refinement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoFurtherRefinement" name="No" sourceRef="Split_Refine" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="UserTask_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="UserTask_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Split_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Split_Order" targetRef="SendTask_RequestFriendsBuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Split_Order" targetRef="Catch_OrdersProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestFriendsBuild" targetRef="ReceiveTask_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_HouseBuilt" targetRef="Join_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Catch_OrdersProcessed" targetRef="Join_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Join_Order" targetRef="SendTask_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="SendTask_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="End_PartyPrepared"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
